verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation or community testimony about real-time multiplayer sync (live cursors, instant cross-session updates without refresh) — items only cover speed/performance (e.g., linear-comm-6) or unrelated agent/API features. This is a fair and mainstream axis for a collaborative issue tracker, but no supporting evidence is present. Missing for 10: any docs or reports describing live/real-time propagation of changes across open sessions.
